title: Pinhole viewer written guide and ray diagram sheet
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: The history of technology (Tomorrow's World)
source: Written for history/y6 lesson 11 (Pinhole viewer written guide and ray diagram sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 11: Ibn al-Haytham and optics. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To make a pinhole viewer, as Ibn al-Haytham described the camera obscura
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: An adult makes a tiny pinhole
Tape tracing paper over the other end
Point it at a bright window; never at the Sun
Draw a ray diagram to explain it

questions.q: Big question: how do we see?
questions.a: Light from a source bounces off objects and enters our eyes
